description: Request to reschedule one of the authenticated customer's upcoming jobs to a new date and time. If a pro is assigned, they must approve before the job moves. Call lookup_scheduled_jobs first to get the job ID. Get explicit customer confirmation before setting confirmed to true.

confirmed.description: Must be true. Only set after the customer has explicitly confirmed.

jobId.description: The job ID obtained from lookup_scheduled_jobs.

newScheduledTime.description: New ISO 8601 datetime string for the rescheduled appointment.

reason.description: Short reason for the reschedule, shown to the assigned pro.

name: reschedule_job
